case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: revised commercial and delivery proposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Offer offer:DEMO-C1-0 quotes €16.00 per shaft EXW; could you provide a breakdown of material, machining and logistics costs and identify scope for a reduction?

Please confirm your earliest repeatable delivery lead time and whether 35 days is achievable without an expedite premium.

Could you consider either package below for the 24-month contract? The first offers faster payment in exchange for a lower price; the second retains your proposed payment period. Please also indicate whether FCA would offer a cheaper overall logistics arrangement.

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA.
Please let me explain.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
Thank you for your proposals and the prospect of a 24-month contract.
While our company policy does not allow us to share detailed cost breakdowns, we can confirm that a 35-day lead time is achievable.
We prefer your first package with 30-day payment terms and FCA delivery, and can offer a revised price of €16.20 per unit to accommodate these requirements.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Furthermore, our production process is already fully optimized for the existing specification, so there are no lower-cost technical variants available.

Our current Angebot is a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €16.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We prefer the package with 14-day payment terms, as it provides the best commercial fit for our operations. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. Any further step needs approval from our management.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Plant Engineer: From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.60 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.46 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.29 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
